title: Unbounded Consumption: When AI Agents Never Learn to Stop Spending
author: Jyotika Singh
summary: Maps LLM06:2026 patterns: denial of wallet through stolen keys, agent-tool fan-out driven by poisoned sources, reasoning-loop exhaustion, context growth in long sessions and model extraction. Demonstrates a simulation in which an unbounded agent hit a 500-call cap while an agent with a call budget, depth limit and fan-out alert stopped after one call.
summaryZh: 整理 LLM06:2026 的攻擊型態：以竊得金鑰造成「錢包阻斷」、被污染資料源引發代理工具呼叫爆量、推理迴圈耗盡、長對話情境累積與模型萃取。並以模擬比較：無上限代理一路呼叫到 500 次上限，設有呼叫預算、深度限制與扇出告警的代理一次即停止。

title: A Vault with a Heap-View: The Uncomfortable Space Between AgentCore Harness and Identity
author: Niv Rabin
summary: Finds that the AgentCore Harness shell tool, enabled by default, runs as root in the same process memory where AgentCore Identity resolves vault credentials to plaintext, so an injected support ticket made an agent leak a service-account token that was reused against a downstream MCP server. AWS closed the report as informative under the shared responsibility model and pointed to allowedTools scoping and egress filtering.
summaryZh: 發現 AgentCore Harness 預設啟用的 shell 工具以 root 執行，且與 AgentCore Identity 解密憑證的程序共用記憶體；透過客服工單中的間接提示注入，代理外洩了服務帳號權杖，並被拿去存取下游 MCP 伺服器。AWS 依共同責任模型將回報結案為「資訊性」，建議客戶以 allowedTools 收斂工具並過濾對外連線。

title: AI 黑魔法（26）：縱深防禦（二），Agent、MCP 跟模型檔的防線
author: Vivian
org: iThome iT邦幫忙（2026 iThome 鐵人賽「AI 黑魔法：30 天拆解 AI 系統攻擊面（重啟）」）
summary: Defense-in-depth for agents, MCP and model files. Agents: avoid combining untrusted input, sensitive data access and outbound action in one session (Lethal Trifecta / Agents Rule of Two). Memory: treat memory writes as privileged, log their source, and review instruction-like entries. MCP: pin versions, re-approve when a tool description changes ('rug pull'), no token pass-through, sandbox local servers. Model files: prefer safetensors, verify hashes and signatures, use an approved registry, and retest on every version change.
summaryZh: 代理、MCP 與模型檔的縱深防禦：代理避免在同一工作階段同時具備「讀取不受信任輸入、存取敏感資料、對外傳送或改變狀態」三者（Lethal Trifecta／Agents Rule of Two）；記憶寫入視為特權操作、記錄來源並審查像指令的內容；MCP 釘選版本、工具描述變更須重新核准（rug pull）、不轉傳權杖、本地伺服器沙箱化；模型檔優先 safetensors、驗證雜湊與簽章、僅從核准來源載入、換版即重測。

sources.title: iThome iT邦幫忙（2026 iThome 鐵人賽「AI 黑魔法：30 天拆解 AI 系統攻擊面（重啟）」）

title: [UnPwn2Own Berlin 2026 / $70,000] Agent2Shell: Pre-Prompt RCEs in Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini
author: Satoki Tsuji
summary: Disclosed code-execution chains in three AI coding agents that fire on an ordinary user action (opening a folder or file, running a routine command) before any input reaches the model. The root cause is a gap between what the agent harness treats as trusted or auto-approved, including config loading, and what the user thinks they are opening. In-model defenses such as guardrails and alignment therefore do not apply. The findings were responsibly disclosed. Session date is Day 2 (Sat 22 Aug 2026).
summaryZh: 揭露三款 AI 程式開發代理在模型尚未讀到任何輸入前即可被觸發的程式碼執行鏈，只需使用者開啟資料夾或檔案等一般操作。根因在於代理執行環境「視為可信／自動核准／自動載入設定檔」的範圍，與使用者認知不一致；因此模型內的防護（guardrail、對齊）完全無法攔截。研究已向廠商通報。

title: Look Ma, No Hands! Constructing Autonomous AI Offensive Agents Using MCP and HexStrike-AI
author: Jie Liau
summary: Chinese-language Hacking 101 session. A desktop LLM client is connected through MCP to a penetration-testing toolchain (Kali MCP server plus HexStrike-AI) so that an agent runs recon, vulnerability analysis and exploitation on its own against lab targets, including with a local LLM. The abstract does not discuss guardrails, scope enforcement or misuse.
summaryZh: 中文入門場次：示範以 MCP 將桌面版 LLM 用戶端串接滲透測試工具鏈，讓代理在受控實驗環境中自主完成偵察、弱點分析與利用，並嘗試改用本地 LLM。摘要未討論防護、範圍限制或濫用風險。

title: Recovering Encrypted LLM Reasoning Traces
author: Johann Rehberger (wunderwuzzi)
summary: Shows that OpenAI's encrypted reasoning blobs could be replayed to a different model, even from another account, and coaxed into transcribing the original reasoning, recovering a secret the first model had reasoned about. Builds on May 2026 work by Matthew Green that recovered PII and credentials from reasoning blobs found in public repositories.
summaryZh: 示範 OpenAI 加密的推理內容可被重送給另一個模型（甚至跨帳號），並誘導其轉述原始推理，成功還原原模型推理過的機密。延伸 Matthew Green 2026 年 5 月的研究，該研究從公開儲存庫中的推理資料還原出個資與憑證。

title: Researcher Claims Control of ChatGPT Secure Sandbox
author: Alexander Culafi
summary: Covers Simcha Kosman's (Palo Alto Networks) Black Hat USA 2026 talk 'A Billion-User Blast Radius: Owning ChatGPT's Secure Sandbox', which chained one-click URL instructions, code execution from a fetched spreadsheet, reasoning injection and a covert channel through a shared JFrog Artifactory back end. OpenAI disputes that it is a full sandbox escape but removed or changed the affected components.
summaryZh: 報導 Palo Alto Networks 研究員 Simcha Kosman 在 Black Hat USA 2026 的演講〈A Billion-User Blast Radius: Owning ChatGPT's Secure Sandbox〉：串接一鍵觸發的網址指令、從下載的試算表執行程式碼、推理注入，以及經由共用 JFrog Artifactory 後端建立的隱蔽通道。OpenAI 不認為這構成完整沙箱逃逸，但已移除或調整相關元件。

title: LLM Heist: Hijacking LiteLLM for Traffic Interception, Key Theft, and Tool-Call Injection
author: Johann Rehberger (wunderwuzzi)
summary: Shows that anyone holding a LiteLLM master key or admin API access can use documented model-management features to reroute traffic through their own gateway, harvesting provider keys and prompts and injecting tool calls the model never generated. Recommends alerting on routing, callback and guardrail changes, IP-restricting provider keys, limiting egress, spend caps and timely patching.
summaryZh: 示範只要取得 LiteLLM 主金鑰或管理 API 權限，攻擊者僅靠官方文件記載的模型管理功能，就能把流量改導到自己的閘道，竊取供應商金鑰與提示內容，並注入模型從未產生的工具呼叫。建議監控路由、callback 與 guardrail 設定變更、限制金鑰來源 IP、限制對外連線、設定花費上限並及時修補。

title: AI Agents Take Center Stage at Black Hat USA 2026
author: Amanda Rousseau
summary: Curated guide to Black Hat USA 2026 AI talks, including post-injection exploitation across agent frameworks (Check Point), credential exfiltration from managed agent platforms (CoreBreak), malicious skills and rug-pulled MCP servers (Zenity), AI browser attacks (Brave), Roblox's multi-layer sandboxing of Claude Code, and the open-source LLMFirewall rule engine.
summaryZh: 整理 Black Hat USA 2026 的 AI 議程，包括跨代理框架的注入後利用（Check Point）、託管代理平台的憑證外洩（CoreBreak）、惡意 skill 與 MCP rug pull（Zenity）、AI 瀏覽器攻防（Brave）、Roblox 為 Claude Code 建置多層沙箱，以及開源 LLM 流量規則引擎 LLMFirewall。

title: AgentForger Showed Why Securing AI Agents Takes More Than a Patch
author: Greg Zemlin
summary: Zenity Labs' AgentForger flaw in ChatGPT Workspace Agents let a single link create an autonomous agent inside a victim organization that inherited the employee's identity and access, ran on a schedule and had approval prompts disabled. OpenAI fixed it quickly; the post urges agent inventories, detection of risky configurations and runtime monitoring.
summaryZh: Zenity Labs 揭露 ChatGPT Workspace Agents 的 AgentForger 漏洞：只要一個連結，就能在受害組織內建立繼承員工身分與權限、依排程自動執行且關閉核准提示的代理。OpenAI 已迅速修補；文章建議盤點所有代理、偵測高風險設定並做執行期監控。

title: AI 보안 레드티밍 가이드（AI 安全紅隊演練指引）／AI 보안 위협 대응 매뉴얼
author: 과학기술정보통신부（MSIT）・한국인터넷진흥원（KISA）
summary: Two Korean government guides. The Threat Response Manual classifies threats across data, models and agents, with sector scenarios for 8 sectors including finance, healthcare and public administration. The 69-page Red Teaming Guide is based on ISO/IEC 42119-7 and has three phases (prepare, execute, report). It defines a 19-item threat taxonomy across data, model, agent and supply chain, including system prompt leakage, jailbreak, hallucination, model DoS, agent hijacking and agent memory poisoning. Scope covers 4 layers and 11 components, including RAG and vector DBs. It proposes a 6-role team that includes legal and domain experts, plus a YES/NO/N-A checklist and a comparison of DeepTeam, PyRIT, Promptfoo, Inspect AI and garak. Structure details come from a community summary: https://discuss.pytorch.kr/t/kisa-ai-ai-pdf-69p/11535
summaryZh: 韓國科技部與 KISA 發布兩份指引：《AI 安全威脅應對手冊》依資料、模型、代理分類威脅，提供金融、醫療、公共行政等 8 大領域情境；《AI 安全紅隊演練指引》69 頁，依 ISO/IEC 42119-7，分準備、執行、報告三階段，定義 19 項威脅分類（資料 D、模型 M、代理 A、供應鏈 S，例如系統提示外洩、越獄、幻覺、模型 DoS、代理劫持、代理記憶污染），檢測範圍涵蓋 4 層 11 元件（含 RAG 與向量資料庫），建議 6 種角色組成紅隊（含法律與領域專家），附 YES／NO／不適用 檢查表及 DeepTeam、PyRIT、Promptfoo、Inspect AI、garak 工具比較。

title: Computer-Use and TOCTOU: What You Click Is Not What You Get!
author: Johann Rehberger (wunderwuzzi)
summary: Computer-use agents act seconds after taking a screenshot, so a UI element swapped during reasoning gets clicked instead, as demonstrated on Claude Computer-Use. Anthropic said Cowork now verifies that pixels have not changed before acting, and the post recommends re-checking the UI before every action.
summaryZh: 電腦操作代理在截圖與實際點擊之間有數秒推理時間，若畫面元素在這段時間被替換，代理會點到不同的物件（以 Claude Computer-Use 示範）。Anthropic 表示 Cowork 會在動作前確認畫面像素未改變，作者建議每次動作前重新驗證介面。

title: The sorry state of skill distribution
author: Samuel Judson, Tjaden Hess
summary: The authors bypassed the malicious-skill scanners used by ClawHub, skills.sh and Cisco's skill-scanner with simple tricks such as padding files, hiding bytecode in .pyc files and using prompt injection to point agents at an attacker-controlled registry. They conclude static scanning cannot secure skills and recommend curated marketplaces, version pinning and controls on who can add or update skills.
summaryZh: 研究者以填充檔案、把位元碼藏在 .pyc、以提示注入引導代理改用攻擊者套件庫等簡單手法，繞過 ClawHub、skills.sh 與 Cisco skill-scanner 的惡意 skill 掃描。結論是靜態掃描無法確保 skill 安全，建議使用精選市集、鎖定版本，並控管誰能新增或更新 skill。

title: 【資安週報】0504~0508，臺灣資安大會CYBERSEC 2026登場，聚焦AI代理時代防禦新對策
author: 羅正漢
summary: CYBERSEC 2026 week report. TrendAI said 74% of Taiwan enterprises adopt AI but half struggle to identify threats, and flagged malicious prompts as a new attack surface. The 台新新光金控 CISO described an AI governance committee using human-in-the-loop review, threat modeling, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001 and ISO 23894. The 遠東新世紀 CISO said BEC fraud now uses deepfakes. The roundup also cites AI coding assistants pulling in a malicious npm dependency (PromptMink) and fake agent skill packages.
summaryZh: CYBERSEC 2026 週報：趨勢科技指臺灣 74% 企業為轉型導入 AI，但半數難以辨識威脅，惡意提示詞成新攻擊面；台新新光金控資安長分享 AI 治理委員會（Human-in-the-loop、威脅建模、NIST AI RMF、ISO 42001、ISO 23894）；遠東新世紀資安長指 BEC 詐騙已結合深偽；並整理 AI 程式助理引入惡意 NPM 套件（PromptMink）、假冒代理技能套件等案例。

title: Update on Exposed MCP Servers: The Threat Widens to the Cloud
author: Alfredo Oliveira, David Fiser
summary: Exposed MCP servers nearly tripled to 1,467, mostly on the deprecated SSE transport. SQL-execution and agent-memory tools were found exposed, as were servers with access to patient records. Three critical vulnerabilities were found in unofficial AWS and Azure MCP servers and reported via ZDI. 48% of more than 19,000 MCP server codebases recommend plaintext secrets. Recommendations: treat MCP servers as critical cloud infrastructure, use cloud secrets managers, private subnets, OAuth plus RBAC, and container isolation.
summaryZh: 對外暴露的 MCP 伺服器增至 1,467 台（約三倍），多使用已淘汰的 SSE 傳輸；發現暴露的 SQL 執行工具、代理記憶工具與可存取病歷的伺服器；於非官方 AWS／Azure MCP 伺服器找到 3 個重大漏洞（經 ZDI 通報）；逾 19,000 份 MCP 原始碼中 48% 建議以明文儲存密鑰。建議視為關鍵雲端基礎設施，使用雲端密鑰管理、私有子網路、OAuth 加 RBAC 與容器隔離。

title: Breaking Opus 4.7 with ChatGPT (Hacking Claude's Memory)
author: Johann Rehberger (wunderwuzzi)
summary: An image containing hidden text, generated with ChatGPT, steered Claude Opus 4.7 into writing false facts about the user to its memory tool in 5 of 10 runs, even though the model flagged a possible injection every time. Anthropic closed the report as a safety issue; the post lists tester lessons such as clean accounts, repeated trials and regression tracking.
summaryZh: 以 ChatGPT 產生含隱藏文字的影像，誘使 Claude Opus 4.7 在 10 次中有 5 次把關於使用者的虛假資訊寫入記憶工具，即使模型每次都察覺可能是注入。Anthropic 將回報以安全性議題結案；文中整理測試心得，包括使用乾淨帳號、重複測試與追蹤回歸。

title: MediaTek Research Breeze 3：讓 AI 聽懂台語、說出台味、守護台灣
author: MediaTek Inc.
summary: Announces Breeze Guard 26, an open-source content-safety guard model designed for Taiwan. It is built on Breeze 2 8B and fine-tuned with 12,000+ records on Taiwan-specific risks: profanity, fraud, misinformation, discrimination and political manipulation. The rationale is that international guard models are English-centric and miss local fraud scripts and culturally specific hate speech. It was released alongside TS-Bench, which is already on the hub.
summaryZh: 發表開源的台灣在地內容安全防護模型 Breeze Guard 26：以 Breeze 2 8B 為基礎，使用逾 12,000 筆台灣特有風險資料微調，涵蓋髒話、詐騙、錯假訊息、歧視言論與政治操弄；理由是國際安全模型多以英文設計，容易漏掉在地詐騙話術與文化脈絡下的歧視語。與 TS-Bench（已收錄）同步釋出。

title: Caught in the Hook: RCE and API Token Exfiltration Through Claude Code Project Files
author: Aviv Donenfeld, Oded Vanunu
summary: Shows that repository-level Claude Code configuration (hooks, MCP server settings and environment variables in project files) could lead to remote code execution and API-token theft when a developer opened an untrusted repository, tracked as CVE-2025-59536 and CVE-2026-21852.
summaryZh: 揭示儲存庫層級的 Claude Code 專案設定（hooks、MCP 伺服器設定與環境變數）在開發者開啟不可信專案時，可能導致遠端程式碼執行與 API 權杖外洩，編號為 CVE-2025-59536 與 CVE-2026-21852。

title: Using threat modeling and prompt injection to audit Comet
author: Trail of Bits (firm byline)
summary: Describes a pre-launch audit of Perplexity's Comet browser: TRAIL threat modeling of trust zones and tool data paths, followed by four injection techniques (embedded summarization instructions, fake security checks, fake system messages, fake user requests) chained into five Gmail-exfiltration PoCs that Perplexity fixed before launch. Notes that small wording changes flipped outcomes.
summaryZh: 說明 Trail of Bits 在 Perplexity Comet 上線前的稽核：先以 TRAIL 威脅建模釐清信任區與工具資料流，再以四種注入手法（內嵌摘要指令、偽造安全驗證、偽造系統訊息、偽造使用者請求）串成五個竊取 Gmail 內容的 PoC，Perplexity 已於上線前修補。文中也指出措辭小改動就會改變結果。

title: Scary Agent Skills: Hidden Unicode Instructions in Skills ...And How To Catch Them
author: Johann Rehberger (wunderwuzzi)
summary: Shows that invisible Unicode Tag characters can hide a backdoor inside an agent Skill that passes human review, demonstrated on Claude Code and reportedly on GitHub Copilot with a Claude 4.5 model. Releases a basic open-source scanner that flags Unicode Tag runs, zero-width characters and variant selectors.
summaryZh: 示範以不可見的 Unicode Tag 字元在 Agent Skill 中藏入後門，人工審查完全看不出來，已在 Claude Code 重現，搭配 Claude 4.5 的 GitHub Copilot 據稱也受影響。並釋出可標記 Unicode Tag 連續字元、零寬字元與變體選擇符的開源掃描工具。

title: On the Front Line of Foreign Influence: Enhancing Taiwan's Information Resilience
author: Adrienne Wu
summary: Summarizes Taiwan counter-FIMI work. Doublethink Lab found generative AI lets actors scale with fewer people, and that varied AI-written text helps mask coordinated inauthentic behavior. Taiwan AI Labs found DeepSeek-R1 embedded PRC-aligned propaganda in 23.3% of its responses to Simplified Chinese geopolitics queries. IORG uses CKIP Tagger and Whisper to detect coordinated inauthentic behavior.
summaryZh: 整理台灣反境外資訊操弄研究：Doublethink Lab 發現生成式 AI 讓操作者以更少人力擴大規模，且文字變化可掩蓋協同造假行為；台灣人工智慧實驗室發現 DeepSeek-R1 對簡體中文地緣政治提問有 23.3% 的回應嵌入中共立場宣傳；IORG 以 CKIP Tagger 與 Whisper 偵測協同造假。

title: 在臺灣用AI護世界，臺灣資安新創廠商奧義掛牌上市
author: 李宗翰
summary: Profile of CyCraft (奧義智慧) at listing. XecGuard, announced in Jul 2025, is an LLM firewall for chatbots and agents that targets misuse and data leakage. It is a LoRA-based module trained on about 60,000 attack/defense records with SFT and GRPO, and runs in SaaS or on-prem. CyCraft also sells Safety LLM evaluation and LLM red-team services, and claims about 20 of Taiwan's roughly 40 banks as customers. Performance figures are company claims.
summaryZh: 奧義智慧上市報導：XecGuard（2025/7 發表）為針對聊天機器人與 AI 代理的 LLM 防火牆，防範濫用與資料外洩；以 LoRA 模組部署，使用約 6 萬筆攻防資料以 SFT 與 GRPO 訓練，支援雲端與地端；另提供 Safety LLM 評測與 LLM 紅隊演練服務；自述約 20 家本國銀行為客戶（數據為公司說法）。

title: OpenAI Explains URL-Based Data Exfiltration Mitigations in New Paper
author: Johann Rehberger (wunderwuzzi)
summary: Reviews OpenAI's paper on preventing URL-based exfiltration: URLs already present in OpenAI's crawler index are allowed, while dynamically constructed URLs are treated as unsafe. The author calls it a significant improvement but notes per-character mapping onto indexed URLs and bit-by-bit leaks remain possible, and the mitigation does nothing against the injection itself.
summaryZh: 評析 OpenAI 防止「以網址外洩資料」的論文：只允許 OpenAI 爬蟲索引中已出現的網址，動態組出的網址一律視為不安全。作者肯定這是重大改進，但指出以既有網址逐字元對應或逐位元外洩仍然可行，且此機制並未處理提示注入本身。

title: Operation Bizarre Bazaar: First Attributed LLMjacking Campaign with Commercial Marketplace Monetization
author: Eilon Cohen, Ariel Fogel
summary: Honeypots captured about 35,000 attack sessions (roughly 972 per day) in which scanners found unauthenticated LLM endpoints such as Ollama and OpenAI-compatible services plus exposed MCP servers, validators tested them, and a marketplace resold discounted access to more than 30 providers. Recommends authentication on every endpoint, keeping MCP off the internet, AI-aware rate limiting and regular attack-surface scans.
summaryZh: 蜜罐記錄約 3.5 萬次攻擊（每日約 972 次）：掃描器尋找未驗證的 LLM 端點（Ollama、OpenAI 相容服務）與暴露的 MCP 伺服器，驗證者測試可用性，再由市集轉售 30 多家模型供應商的折扣存取。建議所有端點強制驗證、MCP 不對外公開、針對 AI 流量設速率限制並定期掃描外部攻擊面。

title: Lack of isolation in agentic browsers resurfaces old vulnerabilities
author: Lucas Bourtoule
summary: Defines four trust-zone violation classes for agentic browsers (untrusted data into the chat context, sensitive browsing data into the chat, chat data written back into origins, chat data sent out) that recreate XSS- and CSRF-like flaws. Finds guardrails were weak barriers, data leaked through DNS queries or search terms, and recommends isolating tool browsing contexts and extending the same-origin policy to agents.
summaryZh: 將代理瀏覽器的問題歸納為四類信任區違規（不可信資料進入對話、敏感瀏覽資料進入對話、對話資料寫回網站來源、對話資料外送），重現類似 XSS 與 CSRF 的漏洞。發現防護機制阻擋效果有限，資料可經 DNS 查詢或搜尋字詞外洩，建議隔離工具瀏覽情境並把同源政策延伸到代理。

title: Next-generation Constitutional Classifiers: More efficient protection against universal jailbreaks
author: Anthropic (no individual byline)
summary: Describes a two-stage cascade in which a cheap activation probe screens all traffic and escalates flagged exchanges to a stronger ensemble that judges outputs together with inputs. Reports about 1% added compute, a 0.05% refusal rate on harmless Claude Sonnet 4.5 traffic, and one high-risk finding but no universal jailbreak across roughly 198,000 red-team attempts.
summaryZh: 介紹兩階段串接分類器：先以低成本的模型內部激活探針篩檢所有流量，可疑對話再交由較強的整合分類器、同時參照輸入與輸出判定。額外運算約 1%，在 Claude Sonnet 4.5 正常流量上的拒答率為 0.05%，約 19.8 萬次紅隊嘗試僅發現一個高風險漏洞、未發現通用越獄。

title: Agentic ProbLLMs: Exploiting AI Computer-Use And Coding Agents (39C3 Video + Slides)
author: Johann Rehberger (wunderwuzzi)
org: Embrace The Red / 39C3 Chaos Communication Congress
summary: Video and slides of a 39C3 talk (given 2025-12-28) covering more than two dozen disclosed flaws in coding and computer-use agents. Per the congress abstract, it highlights recurring design errors such as trusting LLM output for security decisions, weak tool sandboxing and poor user oversight, shows how flaws chain into an AI virus, and closes with mitigations.
summaryZh: 39C3 演講（2025-12-28）的影片與投影片，彙整二十多個程式與電腦操作代理漏洞。依大會摘要，內容歸納「以 LLM 輸出做安全決策」「工具沙箱薄弱」「使用者監督不足」等反覆出現的設計錯誤，示範漏洞如何串成 AI 病毒，並提出緩解策略。

sources.title: Embrace The Red / 39C3 Chaos Communication Congress

title: Prompt injection is not SQL injection (it may be worse)
author: Dave Chismon
org: UK National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) blog
summary: Explains that LLMs have no enforced boundary between instructions and data, so a parameterised-query style fix may never exist, and frames the LLM as an inherently confusable deputy. Urges reducing likelihood and impact through deterministic privilege limits when handling untrusted input, avoiding reliance on deny-lists, and logging inputs, outputs and tool use.
summaryZh: 說明 LLM 本質上沒有指令與資料之間的強制邊界，因此不會出現類似參數化查詢的根治方法，應把 LLM 視為「天生易混淆的代理人」。建議在處理不可信輸入時以確定性方式降權、不依賴黑名單，並記錄輸入、輸出與工具呼叫。

sources.title: UK National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) blog

title: Architecting Security for Agentic Capabilities in Chrome
author: Nathan Parker
summary: Details Chrome's layered defenses for Gemini agentic browsing: a separate User Alignment Critic model that vets each proposed action using only metadata, Agent Origin Sets that extend site isolation to the agent, user confirmations for sensitive sites and actions, a per-page prompt-injection classifier, and automated red teaming plus a bug bounty of up to USD 20,000.
summaryZh: 說明 Chrome 中 Gemini 代理瀏覽的分層防禦：獨立的 User Alignment Critic 模型只看動作中繼資料來審核每一步、以 Agent Origin Sets 把網站隔離延伸到代理、敏感網站與動作需使用者確認、逐頁的提示注入分類器，以及自動化紅隊與最高 2 萬美元的漏洞獎勵。

title: Mitigating the risk of prompt injections in browser use
author: Anthropic (no individual byline)
summary: Describes Anthropic's browser-agent defenses: reinforcement learning on injected web content, classifiers that scan all untrusted context including hidden text, manipulated images and deceptive UI, and continuous expert red teaming. Reports about 1% attack success for Claude Opus 4.5 against an adaptive Best-of-N attacker with 100 attempts per environment, while stating the problem is not solved.
summaryZh: 說明 Anthropic 瀏覽器代理的防禦：以強化學習訓練模型辨識網頁中的注入指令、以分類器掃描所有不可信內容（含隱藏文字、竄改影像與欺騙性介面），並持續專家紅隊。Claude Opus 4.5 面對每個環境 100 次嘗試的自適應攻擊，成功率約 1%，但官方明言問題尚未解決。

title: New prompt injection papers: Agents Rule of Two and The Attacker Moves Second
author: Simon Willison
summary: Summarizes Meta's Rule of Two and the 14-author paper 'The Attacker Moves Second' (with authors from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google DeepMind), in which adaptive attacks bypassed 12 published jailbreak and prompt-injection defenses with success rates above 90% and a 500-person human red-team competition defeated all of them. Concludes that static attack strings are a poor way to evaluate defenses.
summaryZh: 整理 Meta 的 Rule of Two，以及由 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind 等 14 位作者發表的〈The Attacker Moves Second〉：自適應攻擊以超過 90% 的成功率突破 12 種已發表的越獄與提示注入防禦，500 人參與的人工紅隊競賽更全數攻破。結論是用固定攻擊字串評估防禦並不可靠。

title: When AI Agents Go Rogue: Agent Session Smuggling Attack in A2A Systems
author: Royce Lu, Jay Chen
summary: Shows a malicious remote agent abusing a stateful Agent2Agent (A2A) session to slip hidden multi-turn instructions into a client agent; PoCs built on Google ADK leaked the client's configuration and session history and triggered an unauthorized stock purchase. Recommends out-of-band human approval, context grounding to the original intent, signed AgentCards and visible agent activity.
summaryZh: 示範惡意遠端代理利用 A2A 協定的有狀態工作階段，在多輪互動中夾帶使用者看不到的指令；以 Google ADK 建置的 PoC 可竊取主代理的設定與對話紀錄，並誘發未授權的股票交易。建議採用頻外人工核准、以原始意圖錨定對話、簽章 AgentCard，並讓代理活動可被使用者看見。

title: Agents Rule of Two: A Practical Approach to AI Agent Security
author: Meta AI (no individual byline)
summary: Proposes that, until prompt injection can be reliably detected, an agent should hold at most two of three properties within a session: processing untrusted input, accessing sensitive systems or data, and changing state or communicating externally. Tasks needing all three should run in a fresh session with human approval or another reliable validation step.
summaryZh: 提出在提示注入能被可靠偵測之前，單一工作階段中的代理最多只能同時具備「處理不可信輸入」「存取敏感系統或資料」「變更狀態或對外通訊」三項中的兩項；三項都需要時，應開新工作階段並加上人工核准或其他可靠驗證。

title: Generative Artificial Intelligence Sandbox – Practical Insights Report
author: Carmen Chu, Executive Director (Banking Supervision)
summary: HKMA circular enclosing the first-cohort GenAI Sandbox report, which covers challenges in data preparation, fine-tuning, output evaluation and monitoring. Per Fintech News HK (https://fintechnews.hk/36534/ai/hkma-genai-sandbox-report/): prompt engineering mitigates but does not eliminate hallucination, and RAG or fine-tuning is needed for sensitive uses. Banks balanced English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese data and used masking and pseudonymisation. The second cohort targets adaptive guardrails and 'AI vs AI' risk management. Only the cover letter and press summary were read, not the full report.
summaryZh: 香港金管局致銀行通函，附第一梯次 GenAI 沙盒實務報告，涵蓋資料準備、微調、輸出評估與持續監控的挑戰。據 Fintech News HK 報導：提示工程只能減少、不能消除幻覺，敏感用途仍需 RAG 或微調；銀行在資料中平衡英文、繁中、簡中，並使用遮罩與假名化；第二梯次聚焦自適應防護與「AI 對 AI」風險管理。僅閱讀通函與報導，未讀報告全文。

title: Prompt injection to RCE in AI agents
author: Will Vandevanter
summary: Shows how prompt injection can make agents pass dangerous flags to 'safe' pre-approved commands such as find, grep or git (argument injection), bypassing human approval and yielding RCE in three unnamed platforms. Recommends sandboxing as the primary control plus argument separators, smaller allowlists and command logging, and gives a test method that maps allowed commands against GTFOBins and LOLBAS.
summaryZh: 說明提示注入如何讓代理在 find、grep、git 等「已預先核准」的安全指令中夾帶危險參數（參數注入），繞過人工核准而在三個未具名平台達成遠端程式碼執行。建議以沙箱為首要控制，搭配參數分隔、縮小允許清單與指令記錄，並提供以 GTFOBins／LOLBAS 比對允許指令的測試方法。

title: When AI Remembers Too Much – Persistent Behaviors in Agents' Memory
author: Royce Lu, Jay Chen
summary: Demonstrates a web page carrying indirect prompt injection that manipulates the session-summarization step of Amazon Bedrock Agents, so attacker instructions are stored as long-term memory and later silently exfiltrate user data in an unrelated session. Amazon states that enabling Bedrock Guardrails' prompt-attack policy and the default pre-processing prompt mitigates the attack.
summaryZh: 示範網頁中的間接提示注入操弄 Amazon Bedrock Agents 的工作階段摘要流程，使攻擊者指令被寫入長期記憶，並在之後無關的工作階段中悄悄外洩使用者資料。Amazon 表示啟用 Bedrock Guardrails 的 prompt attack 政策與預設前處理提示即可緩解。

title: The Trifecta: How Three New Gemini Vulnerabilities in Cloud Assist, Search Model, and Browsing Allowed Private Data Exfiltration
author: Liv Matan
summary: Three Google Gemini flaws: attacker text written into GCP logs steered Cloud Assist summaries, JavaScript-planted search history poisoned the search personalization model, and the browsing tool could be induced to send private data in outbound requests without any visible link. Google stopped rendering links in log summaries, rolled back the model and blocked browsing-tool exfiltration.
summaryZh: 揭露 Gemini 三個漏洞：寫入 GCP 日誌的攻擊文字會操弄 Cloud Assist 摘要、以 JavaScript 植入的搜尋紀錄污染個人化模型、瀏覽工具可被誘導在對外請求中直接夾帶私密資料而不需任何可見連結。Google 已停止在日誌摘要中呈現連結、回滾模型並封鎖瀏覽工具外洩。

title: 第八天之二：當AI平台遭遇駭客：工程師必知的17種AI資安攻擊手法
author: genai_insights
org: iThome iT邦幫忙（2025 iThome 鐵人賽「生成式AI洞察」系列）
summary: Traditional Chinese catalog of 17 attack techniques against multi-component AI platforms, grouped by asset (prompts, tools, resources, metadata, configuration). Covered: indirect prompt injection via tool output, tool misuse, tool shadowing, typosquatted tools and MCP servers, tool poisoning, sandbox escape, data exfiltration and MITM. Based on a third-party compilation; defenses are not detailed.
summaryZh: 以繁體中文整理多組件 AI 平台的 17 種攻擊手法，依提示、工具、資源、中繼資料、組態五類資產分類，包括經工具輸出的間接提示注入、工具誤用、工具影子攻擊、名稱仿冒的工具或 MCP 伺服器、工具毒化、沙箱逃逸、資料滲漏與中間人攻擊。整理自第三方資料，未詳述防禦。

sources.title: iThome iT邦幫忙（2025 iThome 鐵人賽「生成式AI洞察」系列）

title: Wrap Up: The Month of AI Bugs
author: Johann Rehberger (wunderwuzzi)
summary: Index of a 29-post series disclosing flaws in about 13 coding assistants and agents, including ChatGPT and Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Google Jules, Amazon Q Developer, AWS Kiro, Windsurf, Devin, OpenHands, Manus, Cline and Amp. Recurring classes include exfiltration via images, Mermaid diagrams and DNS, RCE through agent config changes, invisible-Unicode injection, memory persistence and a self-spreading AI virus.
summaryZh: 彙整 29 篇系列揭露文，涵蓋約 13 款程式助理與代理（ChatGPT／Codex、Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Google Jules、Amazon Q Developer、AWS Kiro、Windsurf、Devin、OpenHands、Manus、Cline、Amp）。反覆出現的漏洞類型包括經影像、Mermaid 圖表與 DNS 外洩、改寫代理設定檔達成 RCE、不可見 Unicode 注入、記憶持久化，以及可自我傳播的 AI 病毒。

title: s1ngularity: The Nx Supply Chain Breach That Weaponized AI
author: Boaz Barzel
summary: Malicious Nx npm releases published on 2025-08-26 invoked locally installed AI CLIs (Claude, Gemini and Amazon Q) with permission-bypass flags, and the campaign compromised thousands of GitHub repositories, leaking credentials and cloud secrets. Advises treating install scripts as untrusted and watching for AI-tool permission-bypass flags.
summaryZh: 2025-08-26 發布的惡意 Nx npm 套件會呼叫本機安裝的 AI CLI（Claude、Gemini、Amazon Q）並帶入繞過權限的參數，整起事件導致數千個 GitHub 儲存庫受害、憑證與雲端機密外洩。建議把安裝腳本視為不可信，並監控 AI 工具的權限繞過參數。

title: ESET discovers PromptLock, the first AI-powered ransomware
author: Anton Cherepanov, Peter Strýček
summary: ESET identified PromptLock, a ransomware sample that runs a local model to generate cross-platform Lua scripts on the fly and decides whether to steal or encrypt files based on hard-coded prompts. ESET later noted that it closely matches an academic research prototype, so it is a proof of concept rather than malware seen in real attacks.
summaryZh: ESET 發現 PromptLock 勒索軟體樣本，它在本機執行模型、依內建提示即時產生跨平台 Lua 腳本，並自行決定竊取或加密檔案。ESET 之後補充其與某學術研究原型高度相符，屬概念驗證，未見於實際攻擊。

title: Safeguarding VS Code against prompt injections
author: Michael Stepankin
summary: Details Copilot Chat agent-mode flaws where indirect prompt injection leaked a GitHub token through a regex-based trusted-domain check and the Simple Browser, and where edits saved before user review could change settings.json or mcp.json to run commands. Describes the fixes and recommends Workspace Trust, tool confirmation and dev-container sandboxing.
summaryZh: 說明 Copilot Chat 代理模式的漏洞：信任網域以正規表示式比對，間接提示注入可透過 fetch 工具或 Simple Browser 外洩 GitHub 權杖；檔案編輯在使用者審查前就已寫入磁碟，可竄改 settings.json 或 mcp.json 以執行指令。文中說明修補方式，並建議使用 Workspace Trust、工具確認與 Dev Container 沙箱。

title: Weaponizing image scaling against production AI systems
author: Kikimora Morozova, Suha Sabi Hussain
summary: Crafted images look benign at full resolution but reveal injected text after the platform downscales them, enabling data exfiltration through Gemini CLI with an auto-approving Zapier MCP configuration and attacks on Vertex AI Studio, the Gemini web app and API, Google Assistant and Genspark. Releases the open-source Anamorpher tool and recommends showing users exactly what the model receives.
summaryZh: 攻擊者製作在原始解析度下看似無害、經平台縮圖後才浮現注入文字的影像，成功攻擊 Gemini CLI（搭配自動核准的 Zapier MCP 外洩資料）、Vertex AI Studio、Gemini 網頁版與 API、Google Assistant 與 Genspark。並釋出開源工具 Anamorpher，建議讓使用者預覽模型實際收到的輸入。

title: 全球駭客齊聚 HITCON 2025！AI 資安攻防成焦點、Team Atlanta 現身掀技術朝聖潮
author: janus
summary: Coverage of HITCON 2025 (Aug 15-16, 1,000+ attendees, 40+ talks). AIxCC winner Team Atlanta presented its LLM-based auto-patching system. Three sessions covered AI-agent risk, including real prompt-injection cases against coding agents (Copilot, Claude, Devin) and red-team simulations of AWS Bedrock Agents and MCP.
summaryZh: HITCON 2025 報導（8/15–16，逾千人、40 多場演講）：AIxCC 冠軍 Team Atlanta 分享 LLM 自動修補系統；三場議程聚焦 AI 代理風險，包括 Copilot、Claude、Devin 等程式代理的真實提示注入案例，以及針對 AWS Bedrock Agents 與 MCP 的紅隊模擬。

title: MCP: Model Context Protocol or Malicious Control Path?
author: Yusuke Nakajima
summary: HITCON 2025 talk on MCP as an attack path. Only the title and speaker were verified on the official agenda; no abstract was available. The conference ran Aug 15-16, 2025, and the exact day of this session was not verified.
summaryZh: HITCON 2025 議程中探討 MCP 作為攻擊路徑的演講；官方議程頁僅能確認題目與講者，未取得摘要（大會日期 2025/8/15–16，場次日期未確認）。

title: How Microsoft defends against indirect prompt injection attacks
author: Andrew Paverd
summary: Describes Microsoft's defense in depth against indirect prompt injection: Spotlighting to mark untrusted text, Prompt Shields classifiers, deterministic blocking of exfiltration routes such as markdown image requests, data governance and human-in-the-loop approvals. Also covers research on TaskTracker (activation-based detection) and FIDES (information-flow control).
summaryZh: 說明 Microsoft 針對間接提示注入的縱深防禦：以 Spotlighting 標記不可信文字、Prompt Shields 分類器偵測、以確定性方式封鎖 Markdown 影像請求等外洩管道、資料治理與人工核准；並介紹以模型內部激活偵測的 TaskTracker 與資訊流控制的 FIDES 研究。

title: MCP Security: Network-Exposed Servers Are Backdoors to Your Private Data
author: Alfredo Oliveira, David Fiser
summary: Found 492 MCP servers exposed with no client authentication or traffic encryption. Together they exposed 1,402 tools, more than 90% of which give direct read access to the underlying data. About 74% were hosted on major clouds including AWS. Most were built on FastMCP, but few enabled its authentication. Recommendations: prefer stdio, put an authenticating reverse proxy in front, use TLS and OAuth token delegation, remove hard-coded secrets, apply least privilege, and log authentication events.
summaryZh: 發現 492 台未做用戶端驗證、未加密的 MCP 伺服器，共暴露 1,402 個工具，逾 90% 可直接讀取後端資料；約 74% 架設於 AWS 等主要雲端；多以 FastMCP 開發但極少啟用驗證。建議：優先使用 stdio、以具驗證的反向代理對外、TLS、OAuth 權杖委派、移除寫死的密鑰、最小權限與驗證事件監控。

title: Critical RCE Vulnerability in mcp-remote: CVE-2025-6514 Threatens LLM Clients
author: Or Peles
summary: A malicious or hijacked remote MCP server could return a crafted OAuth authorization endpoint that mcp-remote passed to a URL-opening function, executing commands on the client machine (CVSS 9.6; versions 0.0.5 to 0.1.15, fixed in 0.1.16). Advises updating and connecting only to trusted MCP servers over HTTPS.
summaryZh: 惡意或遭挾持的遠端 MCP 伺服器可回傳特製的 OAuth 授權端點，mcp-remote 將其交給開啟網址的函式時會在用戶端執行指令（CVSS 9.6，影響 0.0.5 至 0.1.15，0.1.16 修補）。建議更新，並只以 HTTPS 連線可信任的 MCP 伺服器。

title: Echo Chamber: A Context-Poisoning Jailbreak That Bypasses LLM Guardrails
author: NeuralTrust Team
summary: A multi-turn jailbreak that plants benign-looking cues and then references the model's own earlier outputs to escalate gradually, with vendor-reported success above 90% in several harm categories against GPT-4o- and Gemini-class models, mostly within 1 to 3 turns. Recommends conversation-level safety auditing and cumulative risk scoring.
summaryZh: 多輪越獄手法：先埋下看似無害的暗示，再引用模型自己先前的回答逐步升級；廠商自評對 GPT-4o、Gemini 等模型在多個有害類別成功率超過 90%，多數在 1 至 3 輪內成功。建議以整段對話為單位做安全稽核並累積風險評分。

title: The lethal trifecta for AI agents: private data, untrusted content, and external communication
author: Simon Willison
summary: Argues that any agent combining access to private data, exposure to untrusted content and an external communication channel can be tricked into leaking data, and that guardrail products cannot reliably prevent this. Recommends structural designs in which untrusted input, once processed, can no longer trigger consequential actions.
summaryZh: 指出只要 AI 代理同時具備「存取私密資料」「接觸不可信內容」「對外通訊」三項能力，就可能被提示注入誘導外洩資料，而防護產品無法可靠阻擋。建議從架構上確保代理處理過不可信內容後，不能再觸發具後果的動作。

title: Testing Real World GenAI Systems – 2025 Pilot Main Report: Lessons learnt
author: AI Verify Foundation / IMDA
summary: Global AI Assurance Pilot: 16 testers were paired with 17 deployers across 10 industries; results were unveiled May 30, 2025, and the web report was updated in 2026. 13 of 17 participants named suitable test data as the main challenge. LLM-as-judge was used almost everywhere but needs human calibration. Red-teaming examples include thousands of adversarial attempts against a multi-turn airport chatbot and attacks built from seeds tailored to Malaysian religious, racial and cultural contexts. It recommends 'under the hood' testing of agentic pipeline steps. Most testers ran a few hundred cases over 2-4 weeks (50-100 hours). Subject-matter expert demand was underestimated.
summaryZh: 新加坡全球 AI 保證試點：16 家測試商配對 17 個實際部署案（10 個產業）。17 案中 13 案認為「找到合適測試資料」是最大挑戰；幾乎都使用 LLM-as-judge，但需人工校準；紅隊案例包括對機場多輪聊天機器人產生數千次對抗嘗試，以及以馬來西亞宗教、族群、文化脈絡客製化的攻擊種子；建議對代理流程的中間步驟做「內部」測試；多數測試數百個案例、歷時 2–4 週（50–100 小時）；領域專家需求常被低估。

title: Remote Prompt Injection in GitLab Duo Leads to Source Code Theft
author: Omer Mayraz
summary: Hidden instructions in merge requests, comments, commits or code made GitLab Duo leak private source code through an attacker-controlled image tag, and streamed markdown rendering allowed HTML injection because DOMPurify kept img, form and a tags by default. GitLab patched Duo to stop rendering unsafe tags pointing to external domains.
summaryZh: 藏在合併請求、留言、提交訊息或程式碼中的指令，可讓 GitLab Duo 透過指向攻擊者伺服器的影像標籤外洩私有原始碼；串流式 Markdown 呈現又因 DOMPurify 預設保留 img、form、a 標籤而造成 HTML 注入。GitLab 已修補，不再呈現指向外部網域的危險標籤。

title: 【資安月報】2025年4月，臺灣資安產業蓬勃發展，PQC、零信任、產品資安受矚目，LLM安全風險因應成最新主軸
author: 羅正漢
summary: Monthly roundup. CYBERSEC 2025 speakers framed LLM risk with OWASP and cited three real failure types: an AI customer-service bot answering beyond its intended scope, employees uploading confidential data to public AI services, and users trusting hallucinations. Speakers called LLM risk testing hard and recommended automated testing with LLM-as-a-Judge.
summaryZh: 月報整理 CYBERSEC 2025 多場 LLM 風險議程：以 OWASP 架構說明風險，並提到三類實際失誤：AI 客服回答超出業務範圍的問題、員工把機密資料上傳公有 AI 服務、使用者誤信幻覺內容。講者指出 LLM 風險難以測試，建議採自動化測試與 LLM-as-a-Judge。

title: Novel Universal Bypass for All Major LLMs
author: Conor McCauley, Kenneth Yeung, Jason Martin, Kasimir Schulz
summary: Describes 'Policy Puppetry', a transferable prompt template that dresses requests up as policy or configuration files and combines this with roleplay and encoding, reported to bypass safety alignment across major model families; a variant extracted system prompts. Argues that RLHF alone is insufficient (vendor claims).
summaryZh: 介紹「Policy Puppetry」：把請求包裝成政策或設定檔格式，再結合角色扮演與編碼的可轉移提示範本，據稱可跨主要模型家族繞過安全對齊，變體還能擷取系統提示。作者主張僅靠 RLHF 不足（屬廠商自述）。

title: 前資安院副院長吳啟文：企業積極導入AI應用，資安防禦應也應擴及AI風險
author: 蘇文彬
org: iThome（CYBERSEC 2025 臺灣資安大會報導）
summary: CYBERSEC 2025 talk by the former NICS deputy director. He cited OWASP LLM Top 10 and NIST AI RMF, and noted that Taiwan's 2025 national cybersecurity strategy makes AI application and security one of four pillars. He described MODA's LLM evaluation mechanism, which has 10 test items (safety, explainability, resilience, fairness, transparency, reliability, privacy and others), and recommended the WEF six self-assessment questions before adopting AI.
summaryZh: CYBERSEC 2025 演講：引用 OWASP LLM Top 10 與 NIST AI RMF；指出 2025 國家資通安全戰略將「AI 應用與安全」列為四大主軸之一；介紹數位產業署 LLM 評測機制（安全性、可解釋性、韌性、公平性、透明性、可靠性、隱私等 10 項，人工或自動驗證）；建議導入前以 WEF 六題自我評估。

sources.title: iThome（CYBERSEC 2025 臺灣資安大會報導）

title: LLMs can't stop making up software dependencies and sabotaging everything
author: Thomas Claburn
summary: Reports research finding that about 5.2% of package suggestions from commercial models and 21.7% from open models do not exist, and that 43% of hallucinated names recurred across ten reruns, enabling 'slopsquatting' (a term coined by the PSF's Seth Larson). Advises verifying packages before install and mirroring registries internally.
summaryZh: 報導研究發現商用模型約 5.2%、開放模型約 21.7% 的套件建議其實不存在，且 43% 的幻覺套件名稱在重跑十次時每次都出現，讓攻擊者可搶註惡意套件（Python 軟體基金會的 Seth Larson 稱為 slopsquatting）。建議安裝前先驗證套件，並建立內部套件庫鏡像。

title: MCP Security Notification: Tool Poisoning Attacks
author: Luca Beurer-Kellner, Marc Fischer
summary: Defines MCP tool poisoning (hidden instructions in tool descriptions that the model sees but the user does not), rug pulls (descriptions changed after approval) and cross-server shadowing. Recommends showing full tool descriptions, pinning them by hash and enforcing data-flow boundaries between servers.
summaryZh: 定義 MCP 工具投毒（工具描述中藏有模型看得到、使用者看不到的指令）、rug pull（核准後才更改描述）與跨伺服器 shadowing。建議完整顯示工具描述、以雜湊值釘選描述，並在伺服器之間強制資料流邊界。

title: New Vulnerability in GitHub Copilot and Cursor: How Hackers Can Weaponize Code Agents
author: Ziv Karliner
summary: Introduces the 'Rules File Backdoor': hidden Unicode instructions in shared AI coding rules files stay invisible in code review but steer Cursor and GitHub Copilot to generate insecure code, and can persist through forks. Both vendors called it user responsibility, though GitHub later added a warning for hidden Unicode text.
summaryZh: 提出「Rules File Backdoor」：在共用的 AI 程式助理規則檔中以隱藏 Unicode 字元嵌入指令，程式碼審查時看不見，卻能讓 Cursor 與 GitHub Copilot 產生不安全的程式碼，且會隨 fork 延續。兩家廠商都認為屬使用者責任，GitHub 後來加入隱藏 Unicode 文字警示。

title: AI生成越來越真，還有哪些手法區別真偽？陽交大副教授許志仲：人與AI互補，找出彼此看不見的資訊作為判斷線索
author: 紀泰永
summary: An NYCU researcher says deepfake detection is falling behind generation. Fully generated images are harder to judge than face swaps, and repeated reposting degrades the cues. TFC staff note that Douyin and Xiaohongshu watermarks often break the provenance trail. Recommends human-AI collaboration and watermarking for source tracing.
summaryZh: 陽明交大學者指出偵測技術落後於生成技術：全生成影像比換臉更難判斷，影片多次轉傳後線索流失；查核中心表示常見抖音、小紅書浮水印但未必代表原創來源，溯源因此中斷。建議人機協作與生成內容浮水印。

title: Safeguard your generative AI workloads from prompt injections
author: Anna McAbee
summary: AWS guidance on layering Amazon Bedrock Guardrails' prompt-attack filter (with input tags to scope it to untrusted parts of a prompt), IAM role mapping for least privilege, prompt templates that separate instructions from user input, and monitoring through model invocation logs, guardrail traces and CloudWatch. Notes that CloudTrail does not log prompt or response content.
summaryZh: AWS 建議以分層方式防禦提示注入：使用 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 的 prompt attack 過濾器（以 input tags 只套用在不可信段落）、以 IAM 角色對應落實最小權限、用提示範本區隔系統指令與使用者輸入，並透過模型呼叫日誌、Guardrail trace 與 CloudWatch 監控；並提醒 CloudTrail 不記錄提示與回應內容。
